history.note: From Robert's 2022 standings workbook (Pablo and Carlos 37)

groups.Sports: Official result from the league or event organizer, confirmed with a second source. Runner-up = the losing finalist (golf: 2nd place).
groups.Markets: All values are taken on Thu 12/23/2027, a normal full trading day (markets are closed Fri 12/24). Close means the official 4:00 pm ET close unless the category says otherwise.
groups.Props: Official sources as listed for each category, confirmed with a second source.

categories.name: College Football Playoff
categories.settles: Winner of the CFP National Championship game (Jan 2027). Runner-up = the team that loses that game.

categories.name: Super Bowl LXI
categories.settles: Winner of Super Bowl LXI (Feb 2027). Runner-up = the team that loses the game.

categories.name: Super Bowl coin flip
categories.settles: The opening coin toss of Super Bowl LXI, as shown on the broadcast. An overtime toss doesn't count.

categories.name: March Madness
categories.settles: Winner of the NCAA Division I men's championship game (Apr 2027). Runner-up = the team that loses it.

categories.name: The Masters
categories.settles: Winner of the 2027 Masters, including any playoff. Runner-up = 2nd place; if players tie for 2nd, they all count.

categories.name: Champions League
categories.settles: Winner of the 2027 Champions League final (extra time and penalties count). Runner-up = the losing finalist.

categories.name: Stanley Cup
categories.settles: Winner of the 2027 Stanley Cup Final. Runner-up = the team that loses the Final.

categories.name: NBA Finals
categories.settles: Winner of the 2027 NBA Finals. Runner-up = the team that loses the Finals.

categories.name: Men's Wimbledon
categories.settles: Winner of the 2027 Wimbledon men's singles final. Runner-up = the losing finalist (even if he retires hurt).

categories.name: Ryder Cup
categories.settles: The team that wins the 2027 Ryder Cup at Adare Manor (Sept 2027), per the official result at rydercup.com.

categories.name: World Series
categories.settles: Winner of the 2027 World Series. Runner-up = the team that loses the Series.

categories.name: S&P 500
categories.settles: Official S&P 500 closing value at 4:00 pm ET on 12/23/2027 (the "Close" on Yahoo Finance or WSJ). After-hours futures don't count.

categories.name: Gold
categories.settles: The 12/23/2027 daily close of GC00 on MarketWatch (front-month COMEX gold futures). That is the exchange's settlement price, set at about 1:30 pm ET.

categories.name: Crude oil
categories.settles: The 12/23/2027 daily close of CL00 on MarketWatch (front-month NYMEX WTI crude futures). That is the exchange's settlement price, set at about 2:30 pm ET.

categories.name: Bitcoin
categories.settles: The 12/23/2027 daily close of BTCUSD on MarketWatch, which is the price at 4:00 pm ET. Not midnight, and not any later trading that evening.

categories.name: Apple (AAPL)
categories.settles: Official Nasdaq closing price at 4:00 pm ET on 12/23/2027 (the "Close" on Nasdaq.com or Yahoo Finance). After-hours trading doesn't count.

categories.name: SpaceX (SPCX)
categories.settles: Official Nasdaq closing price at 4:00 pm ET on 12/23/2027 (the "Close" on Nasdaq.com or Yahoo Finance). After-hours trading doesn't count.

categories.name: Anthropic (ANT)
categories.settles: Official Nasdaq closing price at 4:00 pm ET on 12/23/2027 (the "Close" on Nasdaq.com or Yahoo Finance). After-hours trading doesn't count.

categories.name: Nvidia (NVDA)
categories.settles: Official Nasdaq closing price at 4:00 pm ET on 12/23/2027 (the "Close" on Nasdaq.com or Yahoo Finance). After-hours trading doesn't count.

categories.name: Magnificent 7 ranking
categories.settles: Market cap at the 4:00 pm ET close on 12/23/2027, per companiesmarketcap.com (cross-checked with Yahoo Finance). Alphabet counts all share classes.

categories.name: Fed funds rate
categories.settles: Upper bound of the Fed's federal funds target range in effect at 4:00 pm ET on 12/23/2027, per the latest FOMC statement at federalreserve.gov. A December 2027 decision counts if it's announced by then.

categories.name: MLB Opening Day
categories.settles: Date (Eastern time) of the first official 2027 MLB regular-season game, wherever it's played (an overseas opener counts; spring training doesn't). Scored by days off, early or late, per MLB.com.

categories.name: Supreme Court vacancy
categories.settles: Yes if any Supreme Court justice dies, leaves the Court, or publicly announces a retirement or resignation after picks close (12/4/2026) and by 12/23/2027. An announcement counts even if it takes effect later.
